tool_suggestions.title: Subscription Plan Analysis Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard for internal stakeholders to analyze subscription plan performance, user demographics, and feature engagement.
features: Visualize user distribution across different subscription plans
Analyze correlation between feature usage and subscription tiers
Track subscription plan churn rates over time
Monitor revenue generated from each subscription plan
Identify top-performing features and propose upgrades

tool_suggestions.title: User Meeting Insights Explorer
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool for examining user-specific meeting and AI interaction trends to enhance Cluely's performance and user engagement.
features: Filter and view meeting data by user, platform, or date range
Analyze AI interaction patterns and query types per user
Compare meeting durations and activity levels across users
Identify users with high engagement for potential feedback sessions
Generate reports on user performance scores and AI response efficiency

tool_suggestions.title: Integration Management Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool for the engineering team to monitor and adjust user integration settings and statuses efficiently.
features: List and manage integration settings for individual users
Enable or disable specific integrations with configuration details
Track synchronization statuses and resolve pending integrations
Log recent sync activities and user adjustments
Provide summary reports of integration usage trends
